_about: talkstick config. Copy to ~/.config/talkstick/config.json or point TALKSTICK_CONFIG at it. Every key is optional; these are the defaults except where _note says otherwise.

engine._types: whisper (whisper.cpp), command (your own transcriber), wispr-macos (EXPERIMENTAL, macOS only, drives the Wispr Flow app)

command._contract: {wav} is replaced by the utterance path (16 kHz mono s16 WAV); stdout is the transcript; nonzero exit = ERR

wispr-macos._warning: EXPERIMENTAL. Plays audio into a loopback device (BlackHole) while Wispr's mic is set to it, with talkstick's sink window in front, only while you have been idle idle_seconds. Wispr has been seen to record the previous front app as its paste target, so verify before use. Build the sink once with: talkstick build-sink
wispr-macos._fallback: set to "whisper" to transcribe with engine.whisper when Wispr fails or you are active

command._contract: transcript on stdin; print a line @sent once delivered (stick shows SENT); everything else printed is the reply; exit 0 = REPLIED, exit 3 = target offline (OFFLINE), other nonzero = ERR. Env: TALKSTICK_DEVICE, TALKSTICK_UTTERANCE_ID, TALKSTICK_DRY (1 = do not deliver)

webhook._contract: POST {"text", "device", "utterance_id", "dry"}; reply = JSON {"reply": "..."} or a plain-text body; 503 = offline; other non-2xx = ERR

_on_reply: argv run with the reply on stdin, e.g. ["notify-send", "talkstick"] or a script that texts your phone; printed instead of run in dry mode
_offline_message: if set, sent through on_reply when the target is offline
_reply_max_chars: trim for on_reply only; the stick's REPLY line has its own cap, stick_reply_chars
_status_prompt: text sent through delivery when the stick sends S (a short press), e.g. "status: one line on what is running and what needs me"; unset = the stick gets ERR
